search.placeholder: Search {{count}} people — employee id, mobile, or part of the name…
search.placeholderNoCount: Search people — employee id, mobile, or part of the name…
search.hint: Nothing loads until you search or open a report card — results are a server query, capped at 50 rows.

grid.name: Name
grid.emptyHint: Type an employee id, a mobile number, or part of a name — or click a report card above to pull a worklist (first 50, refine to narrow).

detail.selectHint: Their identity, actions, sessions and audit history appear here.
detail.supportNote: Lost authenticator? Clear TOTP + set a temporary password — the user re-enrolls from their own login screen (SMS code, then the DMSCO setup key). Keys are never shown here.

credential.mustChange: Temporary — must change at next login

audit.legend: Times shown as stored — audit rows mix local and legacy-UTC and are not converted.

confirm.disableBody: {{name}} is refused at every login (POS, BackOffice, mobile) and all live sessions are revoked. DisabledAt / DisabledBy are stamped.
confirm.reenableBody: {{name}} can log in again; DisabledAt / DisabledBy are cleared.
confirm.clearTotpBody: {{name}} loses their authenticator entry and must re-enroll via SMS verification.
confirm.revokeBody: The device is signed out immediately; the person stays enabled.

password.title: Set temporary password
password.body: All live sessions are revoked and the user must change this at first login. Read it to the user now — it is never shown again.

new.title: New Ua identity
new.body: Creates the identity row only — no password. The person self-activates by SMS on their own phone.

access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to Ua Users
access.deniedHint: This screen needs the Ua Users permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.
